name: Capital City Trail
bio_draft: circuit through the inner suburbs, Docklands and the city.

facts.claim: Shared-use path about 29 km long circling Melbourne's city centre and inner northern and eastern suburbs
Mostly made of sections of other trails: Merri Creek, Main Yarra, Moonee Ponds Creek and Inner Circle Rail Trail
Easy, sealed surface; popular start at Princes Bridge near Flinders Street station

facts.claim: Melbourne's largest natural bushland park, on the Yarra River
Grey-headed flying-foxes roost in the park, with a walking trail and viewing platform from Bellbird Picnic Area
Dights Falls, a weir built in the 1840s for the Ceres flour mill, is its best-known feature
Canoes can be hired at Studley Park Boathouse

Pound Bend picnic area with a 2.4 km return river walk where eastern grey kangaroos are often seen
Gold-mining relics at Pound Bend, Fourth Hill and Black Flat, including the Evelyn Tunnel
Mount Lofty Circuit Walk (4.7 km) climbs to the park's highest point with views over the Yarra Valley
